text:
sara: Heads up — FP8 AWQ candidate (redwood/longfmt-awq) produces collapsed bullet lists on summarization evals. Per-task accuracy mostly ok but list items get merged. :eyes:

mike: Can you paste the eval diff? ROUGE / list_preservation?

sara: quick snippet:
```
model: redwood/longfmt-awq-fp8
task: long-doc-summarize
n=100
rouge1: 0.435 -> 0.432 (-0.003)
list_preserve_rate: 0.92 -> 0.68 (-0.24)
longseq_only: seq_len>512 shows -0.30
```

mike: wow 24% drop on list preservation. That's big. Any repro?

sara: minimal repro below, reproduces locally when prefix_cache=True and kv_shard=auto:
```
# repro.py
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/longfmt-awq-fp8', input=long_input, max_tokens=256, prefix_cache=True)
print(resp.text)
```

lina: could be tokenizer detokenization differences under quantization (FP8 rounding). Also check attention masks for long spans. :thinking:

chris: try disabling prefix_cache + run BATCH=1; also compare to int8-gptq baseline.

sara: I ran that — disabling prefix cache makes the problem go away. Enabled = bad. BATCH shape didn't matter. Repro attached.

infra-bot: nightly-quant-bakeoff redwood/longfmt-awq-fp8 failed 1743216000 — flagging for triage.

mike: action items: 1) lina to check tokenization diffs 2) chris to audit prefix cache codepath with AWQ kernels 3) sara to produce short failing example for infra tests. Expecting quick turnaround.

lina: I'll run tokenization parity + byte-level diff tonight.

chris: I'll add a unit test that toggles prefix_cache and asserts list_preserve_rate >= 0.85 for long docs.

sara: thanks team — will post reproducer and eval artifacts here when ready. :thumbsup:
